user_saw: Operators with role restrictions could pick a runtime that then failed at run time with 'cannot enforce your operator role's model policy', and shared-chat typing previews stopped reaching connected viewers whose presence beacon had been evicted.
summary: Bundles two fixes: catalogs, /model, session create and sessions.patch now reject or mark runtimes that cannot enforce operator role policy as unsupported-runtime, and shared typing drafts count viewers from the live client-registry presence snapshot instead of the bounded listSystemPresence beacon cache.
reasoning: The runtime part adds selection-time checks for a rule that execution admission already enforced (assertHarnessModelPolicySupport, widened in ad9b7aec3fa6 #184930), so selection never knew about it from when cross-harness choices arrived (b46c38cfa732 #147994); that half is a never-worked selection gap or a UX hardening. The draft part depends on when connected viewers began falling out of the TTL/200-row system-presence cache; liveViewerIdentities' use of listSystemPresence predates or sits near the graft, and my -S searches timed out, so I could not pin one cause for either half.
